characters.name: Kari Trestakk
characters.description: Ei snill prinsesse som rømmer fra den nye dronninga på ryggen av den blå oksen, og som vasker opp på et fremmed slott i en klaprende kjole av tre.
characters.look: A slender girl of about fifteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows and a dimple in her chin, her face and hands smudged with black soot and her long, wavy copper hair in a messy braid dulled with ash. Over a plain grey shift she wears the trestakk: a stiff, bell-shaped dress of rough, narrow grey-brown wooden slats laced together with rope, reaching from her shoulders to her ankles, and wooden clogs.

characters.name: Kari i kobberkjolen
characters.description: Kari den første søndagen, i en kjole som skinner som kobberskogen, på vei til kirka på en hvit hest.
characters.look: A slender girl of about fifteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair falling loose down her back under a thin copper band. She wears a long, flowing gown of shining copper cloth that glows warm orange-pink like polished copper, embroidered with small copper leaves, with long copper-coloured gloves and soft copper slippers.

characters.name: Kari i sølvkjolen
characters.description: Kari den andre søndagen, i en kjole som glitrer som sølvskogen, på en hest med sølv på salen.
characters.look: A slender girl of about fifteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair in one loose braid woven with silver ribbons. She wears a long gown of shimmering silver cloth that glitters like frost, trimmed with rows of tiny silver leaves like little bells, a short silver-grey riding cape and silver slippers.

characters.name: Kari i gullkjolen
characters.description: Kari den tredje søndagen, i den fineste kjolen av alle, av gull og glitrende steiner, med små sko av gull.
characters.look: A slender girl of about fifteen with a fine-boned face, high cheekbones, a slim nose, wide-set hazel eyes under straight dark-copper brows, a dimple in her chin, fair skin and long, wavy copper hair flowing loose under a thin gold circlet. She wears a long, full gown of gold cloth sewn all over with small glittering clear stones that sparkle like dew, and two small, pointed shoes of shining gold.

characters.name: Den blå oksen
characters.description: En stor, blank okse med en matduk i øret, som bærer prinsessa gjennom skogene av kobber, sølv og gull og stanger trollene av veien.
characters.look: A huge, gentle ox, taller at the shoulder than a grown man, with a glossy, deep cornflower-blue coat that shines like polished enamel, a paler blue muzzle, big soft dark-brown eyes with long lashes, two long, smooth cream-white horns curving upwards with rounded tips, large soft ears, a curly tuft of darker blue hair between the horns, a long tail ending in a navy-blue tassel, and dark grey hooves. Calm, kind and very strong.

characters.name: Prinsen
characters.description: En prins som jager kjøkkenjenta i trestakken ut av døra tre søndager på rad, men ikke klarer å ta øynene fra den fine jenta i kirka.
characters.look: A broad-shouldered prince of about twenty with a proud, stubborn face, a strong jaw, a slightly hooked nose, bright blue eyes under straight fair brows, and thick, wavy honey-blond hair swept back from his forehead and falling to his collar, under a small gold crown. He wears a heather-purple velvet doublet with gold buttons, a cream linen shirt with a ruffled collar, a short dark-green cape fastened with a round gold brooch, black breeches and soft black leather boots.

characters.name: Den nye dronninga
characters.description: Kongens nye kone, som setter prinsessa til å gjete kyrne på tørre brødskalker og later som hun er syk for å få spise den blå oksen.
characters.look: A tall, thin queen of about forty with a long, pinched face, a sharp pointed nose, narrow pale-green eyes, thin arched eyebrows, a small mouth turned down at the corners and jet-black hair scraped into a tight bun under a tall, spiky silver crown. She wears a stiff, high-collared gown of dark slate-grey silk with a white lace ruff, a black velvet cape and many rings, and holds a lace handkerchief.

characters.name: Dattera til dronninga
characters.description: Den nye dronningas datter, så sur at melka surner bare hun går forbi fjøset. Hun vil så gjerne få gullskoen på.
characters.look: A gangly girl of about sixteen with a long, sour face, a pinched, turned-up nose, small squinting pale-green eyes, a pouting mouth and thin, straw-pale hair in two stiff braids that stick out sideways. She wears a frilly dress the sour green of unripe gooseberries, covered in too many pink bows, white stockings, and pointed green shoes on very long, big feet.

characters.name: Mannen i berget
characters.description: En gammel mann med langt, hvitt skjegg og grønn kappe, som kommer ut når Kari banker på berget, og gir henne kjoler av kobber, sølv og gull og en hest til kirka.
characters.look: A small, sturdy old man, no taller than a girl of fifteen, with a round, rosy, wrinkled face, a big round nose, twinkling bright-blue eyes under bushy white eyebrows and a long, silky white beard that reaches his knees. He wears a long, hooded moss-green cloak with a wooden toggle, a brown tunic with a rope belt and soft brown boots, and carries a small brass lantern that glows warm yellow.

characters.name: Trollet med tre hoder
characters.description: Trollet i kobberskogen. Alle tre hodene brøler når noen rører skogen, men til slutt sitter det til halsen i myra.
characters.look: A squat, pot-bellied troll about twice as tall as a man, with chalk-white, lumpy skin speckled with grey freckles and patches of moss, short bandy legs and long dangling arms. It has three bald, egg-shaped heads on three thick necks, each with a big red bulbous nose, small round orange eyes, one crooked tooth and tufts of stiff orange hair behind the ears. It wears a ragged brown sacking kilt, with a curved cow horn of salve hanging from its rope belt.

characters.name: Trollet med seks hoder
characters.description: Trollet i sølvskogen, dobbelt så sterkt som det første. De seks hodene kjefter på hverandre når det henger fast i et sølvtre.
characters.look: A tall, lanky troll about three times as tall as a man, with bright pumpkin-orange, knobbly skin patched with grey lichen, long skinny arms and legs and huge flat feet. On a wide, bony pair of shoulders sit six small heads, each with a long droopy nose, sleepy yellow eyes, big flappy ears and wispy white hair like dandelion fluff. It wears a moth-eaten grey wool tunic, with a curved cow horn of salve hanging on a string from its belt.

characters.name: Trollet med ni hoder
characters.description: Trollet i gullskogen, så stort at det skygger for sola. Det blåser seg opp og seiler av sted som en diger, sint ballong.
characters.look: An enormous, pear-shaped troll as tall as six men, with rosy heather-pink, lumpy skin, a huge round belly and short, stumpy arms and legs. Along its broad shoulders sit nine small round heads in a row, each with puffy cheeks, a tiny snub nose, small black eyes under bushy grey eyebrows, big round ears and a shock of spiky grey hair. It wears a huge patched brown hide tunic, with a curved cow horn of salve hanging from its belt.

places.name: the Rock Wall
places.look: A steep, pale-grey rock wall rising from a high, windswept mountainside covered in purple heather, juniper bushes and grey boulders. Rusty-orange lichen streaks the rock, and a faint arched crack in it looks like a hidden door. At its foot juts a flat, overhanging stone shelf with a low, dark gap underneath, and from the ledge in front there is a wide view down over a green valley.

places.name: the Church Hill
places.look: A small, dark-brown stave church with steep, tiered shingle roofs, carved dragon heads on the gable tips and a tall, arched wooden door with carved frames, standing on top of a green hill. A low stone wall surrounds the churchyard, a gravel path with a few stone steps leads up to the door, and slim birch trees with yellowing leaves stand around it.

illustrations.anchor: Men blant kyrne gikk det en stor, blå okse, så blank at han skinte.
illustrations.caption: Den blå oksen legger hodet i fanget til prinsessa, så hun kan klø ham bak ørene.
illustrations.alt: Prinsessa sitter tynn og blek i gresset med en tørr brødskalk. Den store, blanke blå oksen har lagt hodet i fanget hennes, og hun klør ham bak ørene. Rundt dem beiter kyrne.
